title: Oct4 clusters promote DNA accessibility by enhancing chromatin plasticity
authors: Huertas J; Maristany MJ; Collepardo-Guevara R
one_liner_zh: 该文利用近原子粗粒化染色质模型模拟Oct4与染色质纤维的互作，揭示其通过驱动纤维进入液态凝聚态增强DNA可及性的物理机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作与动态结合机理，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Pioneer transcription factors are defined by their ability to engage closed chromatin and render it accessible. Oct4, a master regulator of pluripotency, exemplifies this capacity as it can bind nucleosome-occupied DNA. Yet, how Oct4 reshapes chromatin fibres beyond the scale of a single nucleosome has remained unclear. Here, we harness our near-atomistic coarse-grained chromatin model to dissect how full-length Oct4 interacts with chromatin fibres of varying nucleosomal repeat lengths. We find that Oct4 increases DNA accessibility not by decondensing chromatin, but by driving fibres into compact liquid-like states in which nucleosomes breathe, reorient, exchange neighbours, and transiently expose DNA. Oct4 binds preferentially to linker DNA through its structured POU domains, while its disordered activation domains mediate cluster formation: a three-stage process consisting of nucleation of small clusters, attachment to chromatin via the DNA binding domains, and growth that is amplified when long DNA linkers enable fibre bending and looping. Oct4 clusters deform chromatin and bridge distal DNA segments in a stoichiometry- and linker length–dependent manner, revealing a tunable mechanism for controlling higher-order structure. Together, our results establish how Oct4 exploits multivalency, nucleosome breathing, and chromatin flexibility to reorganise fibres into liquid-like states that reconcile condensation with enhanced accessibility, providing a physical route to overcome the transcription-factor ‘search problem’ and activate silenced genes during reprogramming.
abstract_zh: 先锋转录因子（pioneer transcription factors）的定义在于其能够结合闭合染色质并使其变得可及。Oct4，作为多能性的主调控因子， exemplifies 这一能力，因为它可以结合核小体占据的DNA。然而，Oct4如何在单个核小体尺度之外重塑染色质纤维仍不清楚。在此，我们利用近原子级粗粒化染色质模型（near-atomistic coarse-grained chromatin model）来解析全长Oct4如何与不同核小体重复长度的染色质纤维相互作用。我们发现，Oct4增加DNA可及性并非通过去凝聚染色质，而是通过驱动纤维进入紧凑的液态样状态，在此状态下核小体呼吸、重定向、交换邻居，并瞬时暴露DNA。Oct4通过其结构化的POU结构域优先结合连接DNA，而其无序激活结构域介导簇形成：这一过程分为三个阶段，包括小簇的成核、通过DNA结合结构域附着于染色质，以及当长DNA连接子使纤维弯曲和环化时被放大的生长。Oct4簇以化学计量和连接子长度依赖的方式使染色质变形并桥接远端DNA片段，揭示了一种调控高阶结构的可调机制。综合来看，我们的结果确立了Oct4如何利用多价性、核小体呼吸和染色质柔性将纤维重组为液态样状态，这种状态调和了凝聚与增强的可及性，为克服转录因子的“搜索问题”并在重编程过程中激活沉默基因提供了一条物理途径。
